what: 1. Who is racing in the pen
title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: Zwift’s entrant list authority signed . subgroup (pen) id: ZwiftPower’s sign-list adds team ZwiftPower’s 5- 20-minute bests. labels pens 1–5 rather –E:
code: pens <- zwift_event_subgroups(za, event_id) pens |> select(id, subgroupLabel, eventSubgroupStart, totalEntrantCount)  pen_id <- pens$id[pens$subgroupLabel == pen]  entrants <- zwift_subgroup_entrants(za, pen_id) |>   transmute(zwid = id, rider = paste(firstName, lastName),             weight_kg = weight / 1000) nrow(entrants) zp_pen <- match(pen, LETTERS)  zp_signup <- zp_signups(zp, event_id) |>   zp_unflag() |>   filter(label == zp_pen) |>   transmute(zwid = as.integer(zwid), team = trimws(tname),             zp_wkg5 = as.numeric(cp_300_wkg), zp_wkg20 = as.numeric(cp_1200_wkg))  field <- entrants |> left_join(zp_signup, by = "zwid") field |> count(team, sort = TRUE)

what: 2. How w/kg becomes time on this climb
title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: Rather simulating Zwift’s physics (gradient profile, drafting, bike choice), learn relationship real races. zp_segment_standings() returns every best effort team’s riders set segment: elapsed time average w/kg. long climb, time falls power law w/kg. straight line log–log axes captures : exponent shallower −1: doubling w/kg doesn’t halve time, rolling resistance air drag don’t scale power (race efforts include drafting).
code: team_efforts <- zp_segment_standings(zp, segment_id, team_id) |>   zp_unflag() |>   transmute(zwid, elapsed = as.numeric(elapsed), wkg = as.numeric(wkg),             when = as.POSIXct(date, origin = "1970-01-01")) |>   filter(elapsed > 0, wkg > 0)  nrow(team_efforts) summary(team_efforts$elapsed / 60) climb_fit <- lm(log(elapsed) ~ log(wkg), data = team_efforts) summary(climb_fit)$r.squared coef(climb_fit)  # time (s) for a given average w/kg on this segment climb_time <- function(wkg) exp(predict(climb_fit, data.frame(wkg = wkg)))  ggplot(team_efforts, aes(wkg, elapsed / 60)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +   geom_function(fun = function(x) climb_time(x) / 60, colour = "firebrick") +   scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +   labs(x = "Average w/kg on segment (log)", y = "Time (min, log)",        title = sprintf("Segment %d: team %d's best efforts", segment_id, team_id)) +   theme_minimal()

title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: ZwiftRacing.app holds rider’s power curve 5 s – 20 min two flavours: d90 (raw best last 90 days) live (current-form estimate older bests decay). live better guide rider can now, drives model. One request per rider:
code: zr_curve <- function(id) {   j <- tryCatch(zr_rider_power(zr, id, parse = "json"), error = function(e) NULL)   cv <- j$data$curve   if (is.null(cv) || !NROW(cv)) return(NULL)   tibble(zwid = id, sec = cv$durationSec, wkg = cv$live.wkg) }  # 5- and 20-minute points, one row per rider zr_points <- function(ids) {   bind_rows(lapply(unique(ids), zr_curve)) |>     filter(sec %in% c(300, 1200)) |>     pivot_wider(names_from = sec, values_from = wkg, names_prefix = "w") |>     rename(zr_wkg5 = w300, zr_wkg20 = w1200) }  field <- field |> left_join(zr_points(field$zwid), by = "zwid") sum(!is.na(field$zr_wkg20))   # entrants with a ZwiftRacing curve

what: 4. From a power curve to a climb time
title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: climb takes longer 20 minutes — beyond longest measured duration — extrapolate two-parameter critical power model, P(t) = CP + W′/t, fitted exactly 5- 20-minute points: rider’s climb time duration t w/kg hold t seconds gets climb exactly t seconds. Riders race don’t climb 100% curve, scale race-day fraction k (estimated next section):
code: sustainable <- function(p5, p20, t) {   w_prime <- (p5 - p20) / (1 / 300 - 1 / 1200)   # work capacity above CP (J/kg)   cp <- p20 - w_prime / 1200   cp + w_prime / t } predict_climb <- function(p5, p20, k = 1) {   if (anyNA(c(p5, p20)) || p5 <= p20 || p20 <= 0) return(NA_real_)   f <- function(t) t - climb_time(k * sustainable(p5, p20, t))   tryCatch(uniroot(f, c(300, 7200))$root, error = function(e) NA_real_) }

what: 5. Calibrate against the team’s real efforts
title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: reference team’s riders know actual time climb current power curve. Comparing w/kg actually held curve says hold long gives k. use efforts last year — older ones set fitter (less fit) version rider today’s curve describes: good predictions? Leave effort , re-estimate k rest, predict : Expect individual predictions good roughly MAPE — riders differ lot hard actually go race climb — ordering pen robust single time.
code: cal <- team_efforts |>   filter(when > Sys.time() - 365 * 86400) |>   inner_join(zr_points(team_efforts$zwid), by = "zwid") |>   filter(zr_wkg5 > zr_wkg20) |>   mutate(frac = wkg / sustainable(zr_wkg5, zr_wkg20, elapsed))  k <- median(cal$frac) c(n = nrow(cal), k = round(k, 3), sd = round(sd(cal$frac), 3)) cal$loo <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(cal)), function(i)   predict_climb(cal$zr_wkg5[i], cal$zr_wkg20[i], k = median(cal$frac[-i])), numeric(1))  cal |>   summarise(n = n(),             bias_s = mean(loo - elapsed),             mae_s  = mean(abs(loo - elapsed)),             mape   = mean(abs(loo - elapsed) / elapsed))  ggplot(cal, aes(elapsed / 60, loo / 60)) +   geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +   geom_point() +   coord_equal() +   labs(x = "Actual time (min)", y = "Predicted time (min, leave-one-out)",        title = "Reference team: predicted vs actual, last 12 months") +   theme_minimal()

title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: Run every entrant sources power numbers, calibrated k: well two sources agree? Finally, put pen context: entrant’s predicted time sit among reference team’s efforts climb last year?
code: preds <- field |>   mutate(     zr_min   = mapply(predict_climb, zr_wkg5, zr_wkg20, k = k) / 60,     zp_min   = mapply(predict_climb, zp_wkg5, zp_wkg20, k = k) / 60,     best_min = coalesce(zr_min, zp_min)   ) |>   arrange(best_min)  preds |>   select(rider, team, zr_wkg20, zr_min, zp_min) |>   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>   print(n = Inf) with(preds, cor(zr_min, zp_min, use = "complete.obs"))  ggplot(preds, aes(zp_min, zr_min)) +   geom_abline(linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +   geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +   labs(x = "Predicted from ZwiftPower sign-up numbers (min)",        y = "Predicted from ZwiftRacing curve (min)") +   theme_minimal() team_name <- zp_segment_standings(zp, segment_id, team_id) |> pull(tname) |> first()  ggplot() +   geom_histogram(aes(elapsed / 60), binwidth = 1, fill = "grey80",                  data = filter(team_efforts, when > Sys.time() - 365 * 86400)) +   geom_rug(aes(best_min, colour = coalesce(team == team_name, FALSE)), data = preds,            linewidth = 1, length = unit(0.08, "npc"), na.rm = TRUE) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "steelblue"),                       labels = c(`TRUE` = team_name, `FALSE` = "Other entrants"),                       name = sprintf("Pen %s (predicted)", pen)) +   labs(x = "Time up the climb (min)",        y = sprintf("%s efforts, last 12 months", team_name)) +   theme_minimal()

title: Predicting a pen's times up a KOM
text: Extrapolation. CP model fitted 5- 20-minute points asked 20–35 minutes. tends optimistic far beyond 20 minutes; race-day fraction k absorbs . Race-day ≠ best. k median: pacing, tactics, drafting fatigue rest race vary lot riders, individual errors several minutes. Calibration size. k comes one team’s efforts last year (couple dozen); efforts older excluded today’s power curve longer describes rider set . One climb model. time–w/kg line learned one team’s efforts races (drafted, solo). different team gives slightly different line. Coverage. Riders without ZwiftRacing curve fall back ZwiftPower’s sign-numbers; riders neither can’t predicted. Riders Zwift’s entrant list haven’t signed ZwiftPower team. GDPR opt-outs simply don’t appear.

text: zp_result() returns one row per finisher. ZwiftPower ships numbers [value, flag] pairs (arrive list-columns), run zp_unflag() first, pull rider id, finishing position category. Column names verified live responses (2026-11).
code: finishers <- res |>   zp_unflag() |>   transmute(     zwid     = as.integer(zwid),          # ZwiftPower rider id     name,     position = as.integer(position_in_cat),     category,     wkg_avg  = as.numeric(avg_wkg)   ) |>   arrange(category, position)  finishers

title: Race analysis across Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app
text: ZwiftRacing.app scores race, event endpoint already carries every finisher’s rating going race — per-rider lookups needed. zr_result() flattens pens one row per rider. ZwiftRacing keys events Zwift event id, usually number ZwiftPower id. column names verified live v2 API (2026-11). riders outside single race, zr_rider() returns current profile (vELO rating velo$race), zr_rider_overview() legacy live / max30 / max90 ratings:
code: zr <- zr_client()  ratings <- zr_result(zr, race_id) |>   transmute(     zwid       = as.integer(riderId),     zr_current = ratingBefore,          # ZR rating before the race     zr_after   = rating,                # ...and after it     zr_velo    = riderVelo.race         # vELO rating   )  ratings library(tidyr) zr_riders(zr, finishers$zwid[1:5]) |>      # one request per rider (no v2 batch)   hoist(velo, zr_velo = "race") |>   select(riderId, zr_velo)

title: Race analysis across Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app
text: Within category, higher pre-race rating go better finish? rank correlation honest summary — rating position ordinal relationship monotonic, linear. strong negative rho means favourites (higher rating) finished nearer front — .e. result went form.
code: race <- finishers |>   left_join(ratings, by = "zwid")  race |> count(is.na(zr_current))   # how many finishers had no ZR rating? race |>   filter(!is.na(zr_current)) |>   group_by(category) |>   summarise(     n       = dplyr::n(),     rho     = cor(zr_current, position, method = "spearman"),     .groups = "drop"   ) library(ggplot2)  race |>   filter(!is.na(zr_current)) |>   ggplot(aes(zr_current, position, colour = category)) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +   scale_y_reverse() +                     # position 1 at the top   labs(x = "ZwiftRacing rating (pre-race)", y = "Finishing position",        colour = "Category",        title = sprintf("Race %d: rating vs finish", race_id)) +   theme_minimal()

text: Tidy httr2 clients three unofficial Zwift-ecosystem APIs. Every endpoint returns tibble. -disk TTL cache keeps re-fetching stable data. Note entirely unofficial & reverse-engineered. None sanctioned APIs. Zwift ZwiftPower flows need Zwift credentials. Personal data GDPR-consent-gated — see riders opted . Endpoints can change without notice.

title: Tidy httr2 Clients for the Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app APIs
text: Nested JSON arrives list-columns:
code: library(zwiftverse)  ## Zwift game API ---------------------------------------------------- za  <- zwift_auth()                    # token auto-refreshes me  <- zwift_profile(za)               # your profile (one-row tibble) oth <- zwift_profile(za, 1234567)      # another rider's public profile act <- zwift_activities(za, limit = Inf)   # whole history, auto-paged fol <- zwift_followers(za)             # all followers (auto-paged) res <- zwift_event_results(za, 5795672)  # official results, all subgroups ent <- zwift_event_entrants(za, 5795672) # sign-ups, all subgroups wld <- zwift_riders_in_world(za, 1)    # roster currently in Watopia raw <- zwift_get(za, "/api/profiles/me/activities/", list(limit = 5))  # escape hatch zwift_status()                         # is Zwift up? (no login needed) zwift_status("unresolved")             # open incidents, if any  ## ZwiftPower -------------------------------------------------------- zp   <- zp_set_cookie(zp_session(), "PASTE_phpbb3_lswlk_sid")  # robust path # zp <- zp_login(zp_session())                                 # or SSO (brittle) res  <- zp_result(zp, 3590800)         # finishers team <- zp_team(zp, 456) fts  <- zp_sprints(zp, 3590800) rr   <- zp_analysis(zp, 3590800, 1234567)            # race report: per-second power/HR/altitude pen  <- zp_event_analysis(zp, 3590800, pen = "B")    # ...for every finisher in pen B  ## ZwiftRacing.app --------------------------------------------------- zr <- zr_client() r1 <- zr_rider(zr, 1234567)                  # vELO rating in velo$race lg <- zr_rider_overview(zr, 1234567)         # legacy ratings: live / max30 / max90 rr <- zr_rider_results(zr, 1234567, days = 90) ev <- zr_result(zr, 5800908)                 # one row per rider, all pens cm <- zr_club_riders(zr, 456)                # all pages rb <- zr_riders(zr, c(1234567, 2345678))     # one request per rider (no v2 batch) library(tidyr) zr_rider(zr, 1234567) |> hoist(velo, velo_race = "race")

title: Low-level ZwiftRacing.app GET — zr_get
text: zr_rider(): rider's current profile: vELO rating (velo$race, velo$factors), race counts (race$finishes/wins/podiums/dnfs), power, points, phenotype club. zr_rider_overview(): Rider overview, including legacy ZwiftRacing ratings (legacyRatings$live/max30/max90) rating history. zr_rider_results(): rider's race results last days days. One row per race (nested event, place, race, velo, legacy objects, flattened dotted column names). zr_rider_ranking(): rider's ranking / points last days days. zr_rider_velo(): rider's vELO rating history last days days. zr_rider_power(): rider's power curve, efforts FTP estimate. zr_riders(): Several riders' profiles, one row . API v2 batch endpoint, makes one (throttled, cached) request per rider; riders error (e.g. found / opted ) dropped warning. zr_event(): Event metadata (route, distance, pens summary stats). zr_result(): Race results event: one row per rider across pens, pen column. Includes position, category, time, power (wkg*), ratings (ratingBefore, rating, ratingDelta, riderVelo.race). zr_club(): Club summary (name, colours, rider counts). zr_club_riders(): Club members ratings. Pages hold 50 riders 0-indexed; page = NULL (default) fetches every page binds . zr_routes(): Route catalogue.

text: object class zwift_auth.

title: Authenticate against the Zwift game API — zwift_auth
text: Token handling: Expiry times measured token request sent, token renewed early (10% lifetime, 5–60 s), slow responses modest clock skew produce expired tokens. access token expires refresh token used; Zwift rejects refresh (expired revoked server-side), handle logs password instead failing. refresh_expires_in 0 (Keycloak offline token) never expires. API answers 401 token handle still thought valid, zwift_get() / zwift_post() discard retry request . handle exposes token(), login(), refresh() invalidate(); printing shows token status , never token credentials.

title: Low-level Zwift GET — zwift_get
text: zwift_profile(): rider's profile ("" Zwift id). zwift_activities(): rider's activities, newest first. limit total wanted: values server's page size (50) fetched page page bound; limit = Inf fetches whole history. zwift_activity(): single activity id. zwift_followers(): rider's followers (auto-paged, 200 per request). zwift_followees(): Riders rider follows (auto-paged, 200 per request). zwift_rideons(): Ride Ons activity. zwift_give_rideon(): Give Ride (POST). Returns raw response. zwift_event(): event id. zwift_event_subgroups(): event's subgroups (pens / categories): one row , id (subgroup id used results entrants functions), subgroupLabel (, B, ...), start time route. zwift_subgroup_results(): Official Zwift race results one subgroup, finishing order (rank), auto-paged (50 per request). Nested objects flattened: activityData.*, criticalP.*, sensorData.*, profileData.*, scoreHistory.*. zwift_event_results(): Race results every subgroup event, bound one tibble leading subgroup label column. zwift_subgroup_entrants(): Riders signed one subgroup (auto-paged). zwift_event_entrants(): Sign-ups every subgroup event, leading subgroup label column. zwift_worlds(): List active worlds. zwift_riders_in_world(): Roster riders currently world. Live position/power protobuf /relay/worlds/{id}/players/{id}; JSON endpoint returns roster .

what: zwiftverse: Tidy httr2 Clients for the Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app APIs — zwiftverse-package
title: zwiftverse: Tidy httr2 Clients for the Zwift, ZwiftPower and ZwiftRacing.app APIs — zwiftverse-package
text: Reverse-engineered, unofficial R clients three Zwift-ecosystem APIs: Zwift game API (us--rly101.zwift.com), ZwiftPower ZwiftRacing.app. Typed wrappers return tibbles; low-level accessors reach unwrapped endpoints; -disk TTL cache avoids re-fetching stable data. None official APIs - reverse-engineered may break upstream change.
